features.title: Contact badges
features.summary: Contact settings show recipient badges with accessible names.
features.origin: Restored from Molly 8.19.2-4 with compatibility work.
features.limit: The restoration commit also includes other changes; ancestry does not prove every line is unchanged.

features.title: Stay connected when push is unavailable
features.summary: When the selected push method is unavailable, Collie keeps its background connection enabled.
features.origin: Adapted by 0cwa from Miha Zupan's Molly patch.
features.limit: The source describes connection behavior. This pilot has not measured notification delivery or battery use.

features.title: Recipient settings before device lookup
features.summary: Recipient settings are updated before linked-device lookup.
features.origin: Adapted by 0cwa from Miha Zupan's Molly patch.
features.limit: This describes a specific ordering change, not overall reliability.

features.title: Stories settings navigation
features.summary: The Stories entry is available from the main Settings screen.
features.limit: The release tree contains the entry; this pilot has not run the navigation test.

features.title: Legacy payment-send job omitted
features.summary: The legacy MobileCoin payment-send job is not present in this release source, and its old job name maps to a failing job.
features.origin: Collie retained Molly’s exclusion during the Signal 8.35.1 port.
features.limit: This evidence concerns the named legacy job. Other payment-related source and generated profile references remain; the pilot has not tested payment flows.

release_changes.title: A clearer unlock screen
release_changes.summary: The password prompt keeps its action bar clear of the screen edges.

release_changes.title: Stories settings are easier to find
release_changes.summary: Stories has an entry on the main Settings screen.
